utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Good afternoon. May I remind you, Doctor, of the affirmation you made at the beginning of your evidence which still applies. Mr. Mettraux.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Doctor.

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... Last night I finished by showing you a report or information prepared and written by Prosecutor Dzikov to which your own report was attached. Do you recall that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd like to show the witness another document that is 1D233 with an ERN 1D00-2536. Around it is in the English only. Doctor, you will find it under tab 28 in your binder. If I can ask you first to look at the first page of that document. You will see some -- a report again concerning the criminal aggression on the Republic of Macedonia. It comes from the public prosecution office of the Republic of Macedonia and at the bottom you have a date for that document which is the 20th of November, 2001. And in between you have a list of documents which are included in that report. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if you look at the last item before the date, it says: "Institute for forensic medicine and criminalistic. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if I may ask the registry to turn to ERN N000-0162 and that is also 1D00-2562 .

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Would you agree, sir, that again this is the same information that I showed you last night from Mr. Dzikov?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if the registry can turn to page 1D2565. Doctor, do you recognise your own report once again?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, this is my report.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, at this stage we don't intend to tender this document. We're going to use it again with another witness at a later stage. Doctor, I'd ask to you turn tab 30 in your binder. That is Exhibit 1D6, with an N00-2350 ET in the English version and N000-7350 in the Macedonian. Sir if I may draw your attention to the top left-hand corner of the document you will see that it is written: "Basic Court Skopje II investigation department and there's a number, 579/01 with a date of the 15th of August 2001, Skopje, and it is an Official Note. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I may ask the registry to turn to the next page in both languages.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: You will see that this Official Note has been signed by investigative Judge Ognen Stavrev. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I may ask the registry to go back to the first page again.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd ask to you look at the first paragraph, sir. The following is recorded: "On the 14 August 2001 at 1330, the duty investigation judge was informed by MVR SVR duty operation centre in Skopje that according to the information they had in the area of Ljuboten village. There were several dead bodies probably of murdered members of the terrorist organisation NLA killed during military activities with the security forces of Republic of Macedonia on 12 August 2001." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then the following is recorded in the next paragraph: "The investigative Judge Ognen Stavrev, deputy public prosecutor Milan Galevski and Dr. Zlatko Jakovski from the Forensic Institute and criminology arrived at the police station Cair, Skopje, already at 1400 where officials from the MVR, Ministry of Interior crime police were present, led by the head of the section, Ruse Stamatovski, but no site investigation took place because the head of the OVR Cair, Ljube Krstevski,, had told them that the security forces could not guarantee them safety or, more precisely, the security forces had not entered Ljuboten village and that one could still hear shootings from the village." Sir, stopping for a second, is that consistent with your own recollection of these events on the 14th?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is consistent.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then Judge Stavrev goes on to say this: "At 1530 the investigation officials left the police station Cair after they had been informed about the security conditions in Ljuboten village." Again, sir, is that consistent with your evidence?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then Judge Stavrev records the following: "At 1615 on the same day, the duty investigative judge was informed that at that moment he could conduct site investigation in Ljuboten village regarding the above-mentioned case. The duty judge was informed by the head of the OVR Cair, Ljube Krstevski, the safety in the village is being guaranteed by the member of the parliament, Mr. Fatmir Etemi, so the duty judge, Ognen Stavrev, duty public prosecutor, Milan Galevski, and Dr. Zlatko - I think it's been misspelled with an - Jatrovski from the Forensic Institute and Criminology. At about 1700, came again at the police station Cair where the same team of the Ministry of Interior crime technique officials was present together with a team leader, Ruse Stamtovski. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that consistent with your recollection of those events?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Judge Stavrev goes on to say this: But they did not go to conduct site investigation again. Actually, the head of OVR Cair, Ljube Krstevski, informed them again that the situation in Ljuboten had changed again, some shootings had started again and that the above-mentioned member of the parliament, Mr. Fatmir Etemi had left the place. "At the same time, the head, Krstevski, informed that there is information from citizens that the dead bodies of the people killed in Ljuboten village were already buried on several places in the village and around it by unknown people." Again, sir, is that consistent with your own recollection of those events?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Judge Stavrev goes on to record the following: "The head of OVR Cair Ljube Krstevski had stressed again that the security forces of the Republic of Macedonia could not guarantee the safety of the investigation authorities because in the above-mentioned village one could hear shooting again and members of the security forces of the Republic of Macedonia were not present in the village, in Ljuboten village." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: "The head of OVR had also informed the investigation authorities that according to the information he had, at the police check-point in front of Ljuboten village there was OSCE vehicle and their members wanted to visit the place of the event." Were you aware of the presence of the OSCE at the time or is that something that you don't know?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: According to my recollections, I remember that people were saying that there were some OSCE representatives there.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if I may ask the registry to move on to the next page in both languages.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: The next thing Judge Stavrev is saying is: "Because of the above-mentioned reasons no site investigation was conducted." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then it goes on to add a paragraph about events in Ljuboten and Ljubanci and there I have a clarification to ask you. Perhaps I can get some more clarity about this. He mentions having contacted deputy public prosecutor Rosko Karava in relation to the events of the 12th of August, and I will just like to clarify with you whether on the 12th it was Prosecutor Galevski who was with you or this Prosecutor. We understand that Mr. Galevski was the prosecutor on the 14th and on the 12th can you recall if it was Mr. Galevski or Rosko Karava?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: On the 12th I only receive a phone call regarding the event by the Judge Ognen Stavrev. And whether the Prosecutor on call was Rosko Karava, I'm not quite aware. I know that when we went to the police station Ognen Stavrev was there and the prosecutor Milan Galevski.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you for that. Then the investigative judge notes the following: "The investigative judge was also informed that the safety of the investigation authorities of the court and public prosecutor -- Prosecution was not guaranteed because of the clashes that were still going on, so that is why no investigation activities were undertaken. More precisely, because of the military clashes that were still going on between above-mentioned paramilitary formations and security forces of the Republic of Macedonia." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then Judge Stavrev notes that also the director of the Forensic Institute and Criminology, Dr. Aleksej Duma was informed about this situation. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. I would like to show you another document, Doctor, if I may. That's Prosecution Rule 65 ter 153 with an ERN N000-7344-ET and for the Macedonian version it is N000-7344. Doctor, that is tab 31 of your binder. As can you see, it is, once again, an Official Note. On the top left-hand corner it refers to basic public prosecution and a number 653/01 and it is dated 15 August of 2001. And if you look at the bottom of that page, you will see that it is signed by Milan Galevski. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And under the title Official Note it is written "prepared by Milan Galevski, deputy public prosecutor and duty public prosecutor on 14 August 2001." Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I may go through this document with you as well. The first paragraph says the following: "After being informed by the competent investigative judge of the Basic Court Skopje II in the premises of OVR Cair an investigation group was established to conduct site investigation in Ljuboten village Skopje." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It goes on to say: "Where, according to information given by unidentified person from the same village, five dead bodies had been found." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then Prosecutor Galevski goes on to say: "After two hours of discussions about the measures that the investigation group should take and coordination with the security measures, as well as inspecting new information, the head of UVR Cair informed us that in the village there are five dead bodies but the precise location is unknown because apart from the civilian population, ethnic Albanians, no representatives of the security forces are stationed there to guarantee the security of the investigation group. They are only two police check-points around the village, but there are also groups of terrorists with sniper guns and infantry fire-arms." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then he goes on to say: "Because of this situation on the ground, we agreed with the competent investigative judge to cancel the site investigation." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... Consistent with your recollection of the events?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then Prosecutor Galevski says that: "On the same day at 1630 we were again at the same place coordinated with all of the members of the investigation group after waiting for one hour for additional information, but the factual situation in the village that the additional security measures because of military activities of the terrorists, the next information of the head of the OVR Cair was that the dead bodies are buried by the Albanian population in Ljuboten village." Again is that consistent with your recollection of those events?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And Prosecutor Galevski goes on to conclude the following: "These facts indicates the following matters. There is no dead body, the place where the event took place is not safe, no guarantees about the physical security of the investigation group because the security forces of the police and army are not controlling the area in Ljuboten village and that's why in agreement with the investigative judge we cancelled the site investigation for the second time." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And again, is that consistent with the information you were given at the time?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, we would wish to tender this document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 1D72, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, do you recall being asked by my colleague about the exhumation in Ljuboten which took place in April of 2002?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct that you personally were involved in this matter?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is it correct, sir, that the only valid scientific way to establish the cause and circumstances of death is to exhume and autopsy a body, exhume if it has been buried, that is?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. This is the only scientific way to prove it.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Are you aware, sir, that after the events of Ljuboten there were a number of preparatory meetings organised to prepare for the exhumation in Ljuboten?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the witness please be shown P55 with an ERN ETN 002-1148-N002-1148-1 that is under tab 32 of your binders, and the Macedonian version is N002-1146-003. Is that correct, sir, that under the law of Macedonia only the prosecutor or the investigating judge may ask for an exhumation to take place?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: The investigative judge gives an order for an exhumation upon an proposal from a deputy public prosecutor.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. If I may ask to you look at the document that have you now in front of you, as you can see, it is a proposal on undertaking certain investigative actions. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it comes from the basic public prosecution office with a number 1098/01 and it is dated 10 September 2001 can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it has been sent to the Basic Court Skopje II investigative judge. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... At the bottom of that document it is signed by deputy public prosecutor Mr. Dragoljub Cakic. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I now ask to you focus your attention on the content of that document. It says that on 11 and 12 August 2001 an action for a neutralisation and breaking up of the members of the terrorist gang part of the so-called NLA in the region of the village of Ljuboten and its surroundings was taken by the security forces of the Republic of Macedonia." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It goes on to say: "Two days after the completion of the said action on 14 August 2001, the investigative judge of Basic Court Skopje II on duty and the deputy basic public prosecutor from Skopje on duty were notified by the Ministry of Interior regarding five bodies found in the village of Ljuboten. However, the inspection was not conducted out of security reasons. Thus, the five bodies were buried in the local cemetery in the village of Ljuboten without determining the identities of these persons, the cause the death, the time of death, and the circumstances under which death occurred and without permission of the competent bodies." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And, again, is that consistent with your recollection of these events?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then the deputy public prosecutor says this: "The public prosecution office in relation to this case acting pursuant to Article 148, paragraph 1 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, and upon the written initiative of the Ministry of Interior, which has been handed to this title during duty outside of regular working hours on 7 September 2001, gives a proposal on undertaking certain investigation actions, namely as follows." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the proposal of the Prosecution is this: "In order to determine the identity of the five persons buried on 14 August 2001 in the local cemetery in the village of Ljuboten, to determine the cause of the death, time of death and circumstances under which death occurred, and so as to perform an examination and cross-section of their bodies to order the investigation action-exhumation in accordance with Article 244 of the criminal -- of the Code of Criminal Procedure." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the last proposal of Prosecutor Cakic is to say: "The exhumation and afterward the examination and cross-section are to be assigned to the Institute of Forensic Medicine and Criminology with the medical faculty in Skopje." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the witness please be shown P99. It is N000-0162 and in the Macedonian N000-0599. And if the registry could -- well ...

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Once again, sir, this is the information which I have shown you twice which have been signed by Prosecutor Dzikov, and I will ask the registry to move to the third page of that document, please. It is tab 27. Doctor, there is a paragraph starting with the words "since the bodies were already." Can you locate that in the Macedonian version?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I can see that.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... Read it out to you in the English version. Stavre Dzikov says this: "Since the bodies were already buried and there was no autopsy done over them, in accordance to Article 244, paragraphs 1 and 2 of the criminal procedure law, the public prosecutor on the basis of Article 148, paragraph 1 of the coded law submitted a proposal to the competent magistrate judge for certain investigative measures to be taken for an exhumation, examination, and an autopsy of the bodies in order to confirm the identity of the buried -- the five buried bodies, the reasons of the death, time of the death, and the circumstances in which the death appeared. It was proposed that this procedure is carried out by the Forensic and Criminalistic Institute within the faculty of medicine in Skopje. Sir, is that consistent with the previous document that I showed to you which was prepared by Prosecutor Cakic?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that correct that shortly thereafter, sir, there was in fact a meeting organised in relation to this exhumation which was attended by Professor Duma?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I remember there have been several meetings. I don't know who participated at those meetings.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, I'd like to focus at this stage on one particular meeting.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if the witness could be shown exhibit 1D46 with an ERN 1D00-1948.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And, Doctor, it is under your tab number 33. Sir, if I may draw your attention on the top of the document it is a Official Note with the number 601/01. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It's signed by investigating judge Dragan Nikolovski; is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: The content of the Official Note is as follows. It says that: "On 14 September 2001 and due to my request, a meeting was held on the premises of the director of the Institute for Forensics and Criminology which was attended by the director of the institute Dr. Aleksej Duma, the deputy public prosecutor, Dragoljub Cakic, the head of the forensics sector in GUVR Skopje Simeon Zidrovski, and the head of the department for offences against body and limb of GUVR Skopje, Besim Ramicovic and myself." That would be Mr. Nikolovski. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then it goes on to say the following: "It was regarding the proposal for exhumation, including examination and autopsy of the five corpses which had been found in the village of Ljuboten on 14 August 2001." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it goes on to say: "And buried on the local cemetery on the same day by the local population." And then he notes: "The proposal has been submitted by the basic public prosecutor's office in "Skopje." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that is consistent with the previous documents I have shown you, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Judge Nikolovski then goes on to say this: "At the same time, it was agreed that in order for these activities to be successfully undertaken, it will be necessary that additional data is gathered regarding the identity of the buried persons, the location of the graves, the time of burial, as well as other data and reporting, also with regard to the security conditions needed for the undertaking of such investigating activities and with a view on the actual security situation in the area." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And do you recall Professor Duma expressing serious security concern about this matter for he and his team if they were to go to the village of Ljuboten?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. And before going there for the exhumation and during the exhumation itself.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd like this witness to be shown another document which is Prosecution Rule 65 ter 419 and it has an ERN range of N005-0754-N005-075-ET.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, it is unfortunately not in your binder but is it is on your screen now. As you can see, this is again an Official Note but this one coming from the Ministry of Interior, criminal police, and it is submitted by Simeon Zidrovski and Besim Ramicovic and it is dated 18 September 2001. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then it is dispatched to a number of institution, which you can see. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: As you can see, it seems to be a record of the same meeting with a bit more detail. So I'm going to go through it with you. It again records that on 14 September 2001 the consultation meeting instigated by the investigative judge of Lower Court Skopje II, Dragan Nikolovski, was held in the premises of the Forensic Medicine and Criminology Institute in order to discuss the undertaking of measures in accordance with Article 244 of the Law on Criminal Procedure for the exhumation and autopsy of individuals buried in the village of Ljuboten who died during the military operations that took place in the area." Would you agree, sir, that it seems to be a record of this same meeting?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then goes on to list of individuals were present during the meeting. It was Dr. -- Should be Professor Duma, Aleksej, director of the Forensic Medicine and Criminology Institute; Dr. Biljana Janevska, post-mortem examiner; Dragan Nikolovski, investigative judge of the Lower Court Skopje II; Dragan Cakic, deputy public prosecutor, Ramicovic Besim, head of the homicide department in the general criminal sector; and Mr. Simeon Zidrovski, head of the identification department in the criminal technology sector. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then the Official Note records that Mr. Nikolovski, the investigative judge, informed those present that Ministry of Interior, MVR, had notified the public prosecutor's office in Skopje of the armed operation undertaken in the area of the village of Ljuboten by the security forces and had recommended the initiation of measures for the exhumation and autopsy of the casualties." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then it goes on to say: "In accordance with the notification, deputy public prosecutor Dragan Cakic, dispatched a recommendation to investigative Judge Nikolovski who called for the meeting with the aim of reaching agreement on the methods and means for the realisation of the investigation." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then it records something attributed to doctor again-- Professor Aleksej Duma who is recorded as affirming his willingness to effect the exhumation and autopsy following the previously received order from the investigative judge and also stated that in order to avoid any subsequent manipulation of the autopsy results of the buried remains in the village of Ljuboten, he will arrange for supervisors to be present during the investigation in the form of competent individuals from the Skopje office of The Hague Tribunal. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the registry turn to the next page, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So the next comment, sir, seems to be also being a record of what Professor Duma says. It says: "With this mind the institute will provide all the necessary resources for the completion of the investigation on the condition that the public prosecutor and the investigating judge use Ministry of Interior to safely secure the place of the exhumation and that all information with regard to the exhumation emanate from one source." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then it goes on to say: "Due to the need for MVR involvement in the operation, in accordance with the law, we advise the investigative judge and the deputy public prosecutor to dispatch a request to the Ministry of Interior for additional information regarding the exhumation and autopsy recommendation." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: The information requested from the ministry will concern the identity of those buried, the location of the graves, the time of burial, the acquisition of statements from the individuals that performed the burial, statements from family members of the deceased as well as other reports, data and written materials." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then the next paragraph, there's a request which says: "Furthermore, in connection with the request, a security evaluation will be required on the possibility of conducting the operation." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the last paragraph of that document reads as follows: "The investigative judge accepted our suggestion and it will be realised accordingly. He then stated the need for another meeting between representative of the MOI or the MVR and the institute, who will be responsible for specific tasks intended for the realisation of the investigation such as suggesting a time for conducting the investigation in accordance with the security conditions on the ground." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, we would wish to tender this document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As exhibit 1D73, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the witness please be shown what is now Exhibit P104.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Again, sir, I apologise, this document is not in your binder. Do you have it in front of you?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I may draw your attention to the top left-hand corner of that document, it says: "Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Republic of Macedonia, sector for internal affairs Skopje, department for internal affairs-OOR Cair and it is submitted by someone called Dejan Bladzevski [phoen] and it is dated 15 November, 2001. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it is an Official Note number 735 and the subject of it is a conversation conducted with a person Kenan Salievski. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the Official Note records the following: "On 15 November 2001, at the department for internal affairs Cair, after a previous invitation by telephone, the person Kenan Salievski came, born on 25 February 1957, at the village Ljuboten." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then the note records a conversation: "A conversation was carried out with him in connection with the deceased persons in the village Ljuboten on 12 August 2001 and about the funeral. And all this upon the request of the Basic Court Skopje II investigation department." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Goes on to say this: "In the conversation, Kenan Salievski said that he is a member of the village board in village Ljuboten and that he has a complete documentation as for the deceased -- as for the deceased as for the person that buried the deceased." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: To the question whether he can tell the identity of the deceased, he said that by heart he cannot remember them all. But he has them all on a list and that it is not a problem at all for him to bring the list of the deceased as well as the people who buried them. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the note goes on to say this: "Therefore, it was agreed upon that he was to come the following day, on 16 November 2001, and to bring the complete list." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then the next thing this note records is this: "On 16 November 2001, Kenan Salievski called us at the department for internal affairs Cair by telephone and told us that after having consulted the village board from the village Ljuboten, he cannot give us any information about the event or about the deceased persons." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the registry now show exhibit 1D41 to this witness.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, that is tab 29 in your binder. You've said earlier that you could recall a number of meetings in relation to the exhumation in Ljuboten in which Professor Duma had taken part. Can you recall saying that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd like to turn your attention to one particular meeting, which took place on the 30th of January, 2002. Can you recall this particular meeting?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I shall read it? I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Read the top of the page from you. This is a record made by EUMM of a particular meeting that took place on 30th of January 2002. As you can see, the title of the document is Ljuboten case, ICTY investigation and it is dated 30 January 2002. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it records the following: "On 30 January 2002, EUMM attended a meeting at the public prosecution department regarding events in Ljuboten on 10-12 August 2001. Among those present were public prosecutor Dragoljub Cakic; Professor Aleksej Duma of the department of forensic medicine; and president of appelation court, Ms. Filomena Manevska; Mr. Andre Cilic [phoen] of the ICTY; Ambassador Klaus Folers of NATO. EUMM and OSCE represented the international community. Public prosecutor Mr. Stavre Dzikov chaired the meeting." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd like to draw your attention to a passage further down in the document, which is in the third full paragraph of that document started with the words "Ambassador Folers." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It read as follows: "Ambassador Folers raised the issue of investigating what actually happened, if crimes were committed, and if so, by who, would be held responsible. Mr. Dzikov, avoiding giving a straight answer to the question, claiming the investigation -- investigating teams were ready to enter the village on 12 and 14 August but had been prevented from doing so." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And again is that consistent generally with what you have told us before?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, there is another document which I would like to show you at this stage. It is document 1D9. It's in English only, sir, and again this is a document we haven't had the time to put it in your binders yesterday, so we have it here. I will read it to you. This is an investigator's note taken by the investigator of the Office of the Prosecutor and it's dated 8 March 2002 and if you look at the top of that document there's a small title saying purpose. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: All of it or only confidential?

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, if you go down three line you will see there's a little heard saying "purpose, meeting with representatives of the families of the deceased from Ljuboten, Republic of Macedonia, to discuss the operational plan for the exhumation at the cemetery at the village of Ljuboten." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If you go downwards there is a date, the 8th of March, 2002 and a location, the municipal school building in Ljuboten. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then goes on to list the people present and there is a number of people from the village crisis committee, representatives of the family of the deceased, OSCE representatives, and two ICTY people. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I can ask the registry to turn to the next page of that document.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I may draw your attention to the second paragraph of that document, which says this: "This meeting was arranged by Emil Smith, head of mission, Pristina/Skopje as the first of such meetings to discuss the proposed exhumation of the relatives of the deceased who were killed during offensive conducted in the village of Ljuboten by the Macedonian security forces during August of 2001." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It says in the next paragraph: "The main meeting was preceded by the representatives of the OSCE and ICTY having a discussion with the 'crisis committee' comprising of 'elders' from the village of Ljuboten." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then if you can go down to the last paragraph on that document, the following is recorded: "There was initial resistance by the spokesperson of the crisis committee, Mr. Saliu Kenan about the involvement of the Republic of Macedonia agencies. Feelings were obviously running high and there was talk of non-cooperation by the villagers. However, after further discussion, they all agreed their support for the investigation." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then if we could move to the next page of that document. Several paragraphs discussing details of the operation and then there's paragraph -- paragraph number 8, 7 on that document which starts with "anyway," which says that, "Anyway, the bodies remaining in storage at the institute until the process it completed was not acceptable to the families of the deceased." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then Mr. Tucker records the following: "They still carry a huge mistrust of anything Macedonian." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then at the end of these notes, Mr. Tucker notes that: "Agreement was also made for future meetings as the planning of the operation progresses." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, you have also been asked by my colleague whether you had been contacted by the police about the autopsy of Mr. Qaili. Can you recall that question?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is it true that contact with the institute, with your institute with be -- with the investigative judge and he would be calling or she would be calling the institute?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Usually. If police comes to the institute, this would be with the leave an investigative judge.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that's the investigative judge who decides whether he goes personally or whether he sends the police to ask those questions. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that also correct that such contacts would go through not you but through the director of the institute, Professor Duma?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Usually the contacts go through Professor Duma and if it is necessary, he conveys them to all of us.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd like to show you what is Rule 65 ter 1D226 with an ERN 1D00-2440. As you can see, Doctor, it is, once again, the OTP statement of Professor Duma which was taken by the Office of the Prosecutor on 5 February of 2007, this year.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if I may ask the registry to go through to page 7, 1D00-2446, and focus on paragraph 34. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Professor Duma is recorded, doctor, as saying the following: "The only report that I have produced regarding this incident was the autopsy report. I seem to recall that after the conflict or during the conflict sometime in 2001 I had a short conversation in my office with someone. I think it was someone from the commission for internal control, although I'm not sure." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Did Professor Duma tell you about this meeting he had with someone about the autopsy report and the autopsies generally of Ljuboten with someone and whether that someone was someone from the commission for internal control? Did he ever tell you that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I don't remember. I don't think he mentioned that to me.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... Wouldn't have to mention it to you. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is his decision whether he will tell me or not.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. Doctor, you remember being asked a number of questions about the -- or you making a number of comments about the colouring of the body of Mr. Qaili on the pictures that you were shown. Do you recall that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: As a forensic expert, sir, and if you couldn't do an autopsy for a reason or another, would you scientifically confident to draw any conclusions based on the picture as to what happened to Mr. Qaili?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Usually if photos are not professionally made, they wouldn't -- we would be reluctant to give concrete expertise, only by looking at a photo.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And would you agree with the proposition that without an autopsy and just looking at pictures, such as the ones you were shown yesterday, conclusions as to what might have happened to Mr. Qaili would be, from a scientific point of view, no more than a guess. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: You also asked a number of question about the process of decomposition and putrefaction of the body. Do you recall?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that correct that after the autopsy of Mr. Qaili, the body was put in a refrigerated location?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. I think it was put in a fridge. We have two fridges. And then it was given to the burial company.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct that the refrigeration of the body would somewhat slow down the process of decomposition?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: But then if the body is taken out of the refrigerator, the process of decomposition is then accelerated. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, because of the higher temperature, decomposition process is quicker.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. I would like to ask you a few questions now about the exhumation in Ljuboten in 2002. Is that correct that the exhumation in Ljuboten was carried out by members of your institute?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that also correct that you personally took part in that process?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And you recall also that the OSCE, the ICTY, the EUMM, NATO were all involved in different capacities in that process?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, I remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that also correct that members of the departments of crime techniques or criminal technology of the Ministry of Interior were also involved in that process?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the members of that departments were responsible, inter alia, to record the exhumation process by making pictures. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. The technique personnel was present.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And these employees of the Ministry of Interior is also responsible for marking, packaging, and recording all items and remains that were collected during the exhumation. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, together with Mr. Howard Tucker.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. I think you've indicated already that Professor Duma was somewhat concerned about the security situation of your team during the exhumation in Ljuboten. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that also correct that NATO, also known as Amber Fox in Macedonia, was providing security for you and your team during that process?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the OSCE and the EUMM were also at hand to monitor the process. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And can you confirm that the process of exhumation went, in fact, without any problem?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'd like now to ask you a few question about Mr. Qaili and his remains. Is that correct that the body of Mr. Qaili was unearthed and autopsied again in April of 2002?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct that this was done pursuant to an order of the investigative judge?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could I ask you to turn, Doctor, to your binder at tab 36. It is Rule 65 ter 64, N00-4212-ET-01. And the Macedonian version of that same document is N000-4212. Sir, this is again the section protocol, as I think have you been shown earlier, and is dated 9 of April, 2002. And it says that the forensic -- the autopsy has been conducted on the Forensic Institute and Criminology at the medical faculty in Skopje on 9 April 2002. That's the first paragraph. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that it has been done after the order given by the investigative judge Dragan Nikolovski of the Basic Court Skopje II. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And there follows a heading which says data about the case. And it says that"Upon the order of the Basic Court Skopje II the investigative judge Dragan Nikolovski, the exhumation of the bodies of ten inhabitants of Ljuboten village has started who had died during the armed conflict which took place during August of 2001." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it goes on to say that "The body exhumed in the location of Ljuboten village and marked under 231/2 is the body of Qaili Atulla, according to the data of the investigative authorities. In the archive of the institute there is a section report number 1191/245-01 for conducted autopsy on 14/08/2001 of the late Qaili Atulla." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct that this report which has been referred to is the autopsy report which you and Professor Duma have prepared. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that also correct --

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, Your Honours, perhaps we'll tender that.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As exhibit 1D74, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that correct, sir, that none of the other nine bodies which were unearthed and autopsied at the Ljuboten cemetery were named in the section protocol in the other autopsy report. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is correct. They were recorded under a number.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Well, were some of them also recorded as "unknown person"?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. NN, standing for unknown person, number 1.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct, sir, that the reason why those people were not recorded under any name was because you had no scientific proof at the time of their identity?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that correct also that a request had been made to the families of the deceased to provide DNA samples to match those with the DNA samples taken on the deceased? Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that also correct that the families of the deceased refused to provide such material?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Is that also correct, sir, that at the time of the autopsies the institute had taken biological material from each and every one of the deceased and that half of that material was given to the Office of the Prosecutor and half of it kept to the institute?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So that if one of the two sides would manage to obtain DNA from the families, the results would be shared with the other side. Was it the understanding of the parties?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. That is only logical.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Would that such result have been helpful to assist you in identifying the deceased, sir?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: These are the only recognised scientific evidence to verify someone's identity.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And did you ever receive that information from the Office of the Prosecutor?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: We only heard that identification was performed through DNA by the Prosecutor's office. We did not receive the results of it. And we were not requested to perform the DNA analysis in order to verify the identity of those persons.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. Sir, I'd like to ask you questions about another autopsy which you carried out.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that is Rule 65 ter 71 with N00-4206-ET-01. The Macedonian version of that document is N000-4206.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And, sir, that is under tab 38 of your binder. Sir, that's again a section protocol coming from your institute with a number 12126/80-2002, Skopje, 9 of April, 2002. And as is obvious from the first page, the autopsy has been conducted by Dr. Zdravko Cakar and assistant Dr. Zlatko Jakovski. And it is -- the autopsy has been performed on the body of unknown person number 1. That person is Mr. Rami Jusufi. Then if I may ask you to go to the second page of that document, sir. There's paragraph in the English starting with: "In the area of the stomach." Can you locate that in the Macedonian version?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. That is on the third page of the Macedonian version.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I apologise. It is on the second page of the English version, in the middle of the page. I'll read it out to you. It says: "In the area of the stomach at the lower left part there is a smaller part of skin. In the area of the stomach, there are remains of the decayed changed organs, brownie-black colour which can be recognised." Then there are two sentences and then you go on to say this: "After the removal of the muscles from the area of left hip bone, ten centimetre from the middle line and 104.5 centimetre above the feet there is a hole, defective place, dimension 0705 centimetre." Do you recall making those findings on this body, doctor?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then in the next paragraph you say: "In the area of the left side on the flank on the skin there is defective ovals, total dimension 0503 centimetre, 108.5 centimetre above the feet." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, I'd like to show you two pictures. It's -- 1D4 is the first one, Exhibit 1D4.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm told in the binder it is 38A, I believe.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, we've established earlier that perhaps a picture of that sort is not very reliable in itself. But would you be able to state whether what you can observe on this picture is generally consistent or would be generally consistent with the scientific and medical findings which you have made in your report?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I wish to say again, this is a picture taken by an amateur and the injury that is shown in the picture does resemble an injury from a fire-arm which has been described in the section protocol.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. If I may ask now to look at 65 ter 608 under the ERN 0501-6266.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It's in the same tab in the binder, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Again, sir, with the limitations which such a picture contains, would the injury which you observe on that body be generally consistent with your observations and finding in the section protocol which we just read?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: In this photograph, you see a defect in the skin, on the left side of the stomach area, surrounded by a larger area of a haematoma or a bruise. In that part of the abdomen, during the autopsy, the skin was missing.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And would that injury be generally consistent, again with the limitations mentioned above, with your observations in the protocol?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If I may ask the registry to go back to Rule 65 ter 71. It's under tab 38 of the binder. And if we could to the third page of that document in both languages.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Doctor, there is a section with a heading "opinion" in the English. Can you find that.

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the opinion which you gave was as follows: "At the body of the late NN number 1, I noticed advanced decayed saponification and monification processes as well as processes of decomposition." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then I'd like to draw your attention to the last paragraph in that opinion. I believe it is the next page in the Macedonian, still page 3 in the English. First I should have read to you perhaps this passage. It says that, "In the area of the remains of the stomach skin on the left side an oval cut has been found." That's what you described earlier. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: It says, apart from that, "A defective hole has been found on the left hip bone as well as a hole cut of the skin in the area of the left flank." And again that's is consistent with what you said earlier. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then if we may look at this last paragraph you have said the following: "The changes that have been noticed indicate that this change is caused by projectile fired by fire-arm in the area of the lower third of the stomach on the left side with probable movement in the body from front towards back, from right towards left, and from down towards up." Is that correct? That's what the opinion says?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And is that correct that you were able to determine that the bullet had come from the front to the back, because you found small pieces of bones which came from the front of the body and which were towards the back of the hole at the time of the autopsy?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: During the autopsy, in the left hip bone, in the area of the defect, found were -- found was that the rear, the posterior compact part of the bone was moved towards the back, which indicates that the projectile had the trajectory from the front to the back.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And you also concluded in your opinion that the bullet had come from down towards up. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And you were able to do that by measuring the heighth of the hole at the front of the body from the feet and by doing the same measurements at the back, and again from the feet? Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: We made this conclusion on the basis of measurements of the heighth of the fire-arm injury in the left femur and the defect found in the area of the left part of the abdomen, because there was a difference in the heighth of the respective injuries of four centimetres. We were able to conclude that the projectile was headed from below to -- from below upwards.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So practically, Doctor, it means that the person who shot into the body was placed under the body. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. He had a lower position in relation to the person that was the subject of the autopsy.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Would that be a convenient time, Your Honour?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: We had thought to stretch a little, Mr. Mettraux. Is it inconvenient to you to --

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Not at all, Your Honour, not at all. I had forgotten that stretching.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Well, that will give us an extra ten minutes or so and that's in everybody's interests. So we will run for eight or ten minutes further from now.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, there is another document which I would like to show to you at this stage. It is -- it has been marked as MFI 1D5. And it is it in your binder at tab 43. But before I ask you to look at the document, perhaps I'll ask you this: Is that correct, sir, that at the time of carrying out an autopsy on a particular body which had been exhumed in Ljuboten, 26 rounds of live ammunitions were found in his pockets?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: It is true.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And were you present, sir, at the time when the bullets were found?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I was one of the many people present, but I was present only as an observer. I did not participate in that autopsy.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And do you recall who the doctor in charge was at the time?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: For that autopsy?

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Professor Dr. Karpos Boskovski and the assistant, Dr. Natasa Davceva.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And do you recall, sir, whether at the time when this 26 live rounds of ammunition were found, Mr. Tucker was present, the OTP investigator?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. Mr. Tucker and Eric Bakar [phoen].

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And Eric Bakar was a French forensic expert, is that correct, who came with the ICTY team?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. In a capacity of an expert and observer.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. I'd lake to go to the documents that you have in front of you, starting with the top of the left page, top left-hand corner. It is again a document that comes from the Lower Court II in Skopje and it has again this number N 01 -- sorry, 601/01, and it is dated 9 May 2002, Skopje. And it has a title "report on the exhumations conducted in Ljuboten and the subsequent autopsies." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it says the following in the first paragraph: "Upon my order, identity N 601-01 of 3 April 2002 issued on the basis of the proposal of the lower public prosecutor in Skopje, XXRO number 1098/01, of 10 September 2001, for conducting special investigative actions, the procedure for exhumation of ten bodies buried in the course of August 2001 at the Muslim graveyard in the village of Ljuboten in the Skopje area began on April 8th, 2002 in my presence." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And goes on to say: "It was also attended by the investigating judge of this court Beqir Shinji [phoen]; authorised officers from the Institute of the Forensic Medicine and Criminology at the university centre for medical science in Skopje; the forensics sectors at the Ministry of the Interior of the Republic of Macedonia as well as representatives of the International Criminal Tribunal for the Former Yugoslavia; Mr. Howard Tucker, investigator, and Eric Bakar, forensic pathologist. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And the next paragraph says that the aim of the exhumation and subsequent autopsies of these ten bodies was to establish the cause and time of death and to enable identification of the bodies." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'll ask the registry now to turn to page 5 in the English. I think I have located the Macedonian page as page number 6.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, that would be the last half paragraph of page 6 of the Macedonian version. And it is also the last paragraph on page 5 of the English.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: I'm told, Mr. Mettraux, that only one page of the translation is in e-court, the balance having been received only today and it has not yet been possible to include it.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: I'm told the same thing from my side of the courtroom, Your Honour. I understand that we have received the official translation today, so what we'll do is --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Would you like to consider what to do about that over the break?

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Absolutely.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Very well. We will adjourn now and we resume at 25 minutes past 4.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Mettraux.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. We've queried the matter further. The translation in English has been available for a few days now. We have also scanned and sent the document and we are-- are awaiting the uploading, and we are told it can happen either today or tomorrow. For the time being, with the kind assistance of the usher, we will place the document on the ELMO.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And, Doctor, that is still the document under tab 43 of your binder?

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: If the usher could place the first page of that document on the ELMO. 43, Doctor.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: No, that would not be the first page. That would be this page written report on the exhumations. Page number 1, please. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: So, Doctor, that's -- for identification purposes, that is the same document that I have just shown you before. It's a report on the exhumations conducted in Ljuboten and the subsequent autopsies, and I have read to you the first and second paragraph of that document.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And I'll ask now the usher to go to the fifth page of that document, please. And if you could focus on the last paragraph of that page, please. Further down, please. A bit further. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Doctor, I'll ask you to look at the last paragraph on that page and I'll read it out to you. It says: "At 1500 hours the autopsies continued with the body with reference number 236/5, Xhelal Bajrami. The autopsy began at 1530 hours after the usual preliminary procedure of the body being taken from the cooler and transported to the autopsy room." And if we could go to page 6, please, at the top. Thank you. It says: "The blanket in which the body was wrapped was removed, revealing a body dressed in a black shirt and jeans with a belt as well as low rubber sandals." Can you see that, doctor?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Then it says this: "It was established that the clothing was damaged. Fire-arm projectiles and metal fragments were found in the body during the autopsy. More details on the findings are given in the autopsy protocol. The left front pocket of the jeans contained 26 bullets for fire-arm." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And that is consistent with what have you told us before. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And then the report goes on to say: "All of the ballistic material found was labelled and retained for analysis by Mr. Tucker, as was also done with the biological material. The autopsy was completed at 2102 hours." And is that, again, consistent with your memory of those events, sir?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Your Honour, we would wish to tender this document.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Perhaps simply for the record I will ask the usher to place the last page on the ELMO to identify the signature, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Doctor, is that correct that the document was signed by investigative judge Dragan Nikolovski?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: That last document, I believe, was marked for identification and will now become an exhibit with the same number.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you very much. Could the witness please be shown Prosecution Exhibit P49 with an ERN ET-0001-0090-01, and the Macedonian is N001-0000-92.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Doctor, it is tab 34 of your binder.

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: I would just like to ask the usher if you can switch on the second monitor. [In English] Thank you. It is okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, is that correct that the authority which is competent to ask for and receive an autopsy report is the investigative judge?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if I may ask you to look at this document in front of you, starting with the subject heading, it is a request for an autopsy report. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it comes from investigative judge Dragan Nikolovski. You have his signature on the bottom right-hand corner. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And on the top right-hand corner of the document it is -- the recipients of the -- of this document the Institute of Forensic Medicine and Criminology, Skopje. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And if we go into the text of that document, it says that: "In connection with the procedure for exhumation and examination of ten bodies in Ljuboten village buried in August 2001, we hereby request that you send us a report from the autopsy of Atulla Qaili, son of Avdi, born on 3 November 1965 from Ljuboten village which was performed in your institute on 14 and 15 August 2001," and the request is dated 9 April 2002. Sir, can you recall receiving this request or Professor Duma receiving this request?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Regarding this request, we submitted this autopsy protocol to the investigation judge.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Could the witness please be shown what is now P289. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Sir, you will recall you were shown this document by my colleague from the Prosecution. Do you recall that document?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Before looking into the substance of that document may I draw your attention to the top left-hand corner of that document, and there's a date that is the date of the document and it is the 22nd of May, 2003. Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: 22nd of May.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Yes. And the document which is the delivery of autopsy protocol is sent from university medical faculty, forensic and criminological institute to the Basic Court Skopje II, Judge Dragan Nikolovski. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And I'd like to go into the substance of that document with you. The letter sent by Professor Duma- I think you have been shown the signature already - says this: "We would like to send you the autopsy protocol from autopsies of the corpses exhumed in the Ljuboten village." Can you see that?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: And it says that "These exhumations were performed upon your order in the time from 9 April 2003 to 23 April 2003." Sir, is that correct that the autopsies -- the exhumations, I'm sorry, were in fact done in April of 2002?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: But it's correct that they were done in the presence of observers from the ICTY, isn't that? Isn't it correct?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, that is correct, Eric Bakar and Howard Tucker.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Thank you. And the letter goes on to say that "This decision was brought by a team of professionals composed of the core professional staff, professors only, it has handed over after the meeting with the higher-ranked officials from the ICTY who are liable for the Balkans," I suppose it should be responsible, "under auspices of the president of the Basic Court Skopje II and at the premises of the Forensic Institute at the medical faculty in Skopje." Sir, that reference to a meeting with the president of the Basic Court and higher-ranked officials of the ICTY at the premises of the institute of the medical faculty, is that consistent with a meeting of 30th January 2002, which we discussed earlier?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. METTRAUX
utterances.text: Perhaps I should also ask you this: Are you aware of any other meetings prior to January 2002 attended by the Office of the Prosecutor of this Tribunal with Professor Duma or any other members of your institute?

utterances.speaker: ZLATKO JAKOVSKI [Resumed]
